node.statement: Dependency-correct final assembly, independent of pending node 1.5. Once direct multiplicativity node 1.6.1.2 and validated nodes 1.1, 1.2, and 1.4 are validated premises, fix n>=1. Node 1.1 supplies the target extended C_ca*e-C*-algebra and the universal threshold ledger; node 1.2 supplies linearity, correct target, exact dagger preservation, and zero unit defect for T_n; node 1.6.1.2 supplies multiplicative defect at most K_M*e||x||||y||; and node 1.4 supplies (1-K_N*e)||x||<=||T_n(x)||<=(1+K_N*e)||x||. With C_co=max{1,C_ca,K_N,K_M}, every required defect and target parameter is at most C_co*e, so T_n is a C_co*e-inclusion by def-extended-delta-inclusion. Since n is arbitrary, T is an extended C_co*e-inclusion. Substituting e=alpha+epsilon and taking e_co to be the positive minimum of the universal thresholds gives the root contract, uniformly in n and the ideal dimension. This derivation has no dependency on node 1.5.
